name.value: The Kitchen Dada Sushi Bar & Grill

description.value: The Kitchen Dada is a sushi bar and grill on Alma Street in Vancouver with a capacity of 30, named as a nod to the Dada art movement of the First World War era. The restaurant leans into its namesake with an eclectic identity — part neighbourhood Japanese eatery, part art-inflected concept. It offers dine-in, takeout, and online delivery, with daily specials posted regularly.
